findings.message: zeebe:taskHeaders has no Camunda 7 equivalent and was dropped.
findings.suggestion: Reimplement the behavior in Camunda 7 or accept the difference.

findings.message: FEEL condition "=paid = true" kept as-is; Camunda 7 evaluates JUEL.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite the condition as a JUEL expression.

findings.message: zeebe:userTask has no Camunda 7 equivalent and was dropped.
findings.suggestion: Reimplement the behavior in Camunda 7 or accept the difference.

findings.message: Connector "io.camunda:http-json:1" has no Camunda 7 runtime; it becomes a plain external task.
findings.suggestion: Implement an external task worker for this topic.

findings.message: zeebe:taskHeaders has no Camunda 7 equivalent and was dropped.
findings.suggestion: Reimplement the behavior in Camunda 7 or accept the difference.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" id="Definitions_testing" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirm" name="payment-confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:process id="order-process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="payment" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="payment" name="Charge card">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_paid</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="paid_gw" default="f_unpaid">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_paid</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_ship</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_unpaid</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ship" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="ship" name="Ship">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_ship</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_shipped</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_ok">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_shipped</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_cancel">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_unpaid</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_start" sourceRef="start" targetRef="payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_paid" sourceRef="payment" targetRef="paid_gw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_ship" sourceRef="paid_gw" targetRef="ship">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=paid = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_unpaid" sourceRef="paid_gw" targetRef="end_cancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_shipped" sourceRef="ship" targetRef="end_ok"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="timer-process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="t_start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>tf1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="wait_hour">
      <bpmn:incoming>tf1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>tf2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT1H</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="t_end">
      <bpmn:incoming>tf2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="tf1" sourceRef="t_start" targetRef="wait_hour"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="tf2" sourceRef="wait_hour" targetRef="t_end"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="date-process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="d_start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>df1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="wait_new_year">
      <bpmn:incoming>df1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>df2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDate>2027-01-01T00:00:00Z</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="d_end">
      <bpmn:incoming>df2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="df1" sourceRef="d_start" targetRef="wait_new_year"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="df2" sourceRef="wait_new_year" targetRef="d_end"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="review-process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="r_start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>rf1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="review" name="Review">
      <bpmn:incoming>rf1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rf2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="review_timeout" attachedToRef="review">
      <bpmn:outgoing>rf3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P1D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="r_done">
      <bpmn:incoming>rf2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="escalate" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="escalate">
      <bpmn:incoming>rf3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rf4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="r_escalated">
      <bpmn:incoming>rf4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rf1" sourceRef="r_start" targetRef="review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rf2" sourceRef="review" targetRef="r_done"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rf3" sourceRef="review_timeout" targetRef="escalate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rf4" sourceRef="escalate" targetRef="r_escalated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="message-process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="m_start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>mf1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="await_confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>mf1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>mf2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Msg_Confirm"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="m_end">
      <bpmn:incoming>mf2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="mf1" sourceRef="m_start" targetRef="await_confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="mf2" sourceRef="await_confirmation" targetRef="m_end"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="connector-process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="c_start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>cf1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="fetch_weather" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1">
      <bpmn:incoming>cf1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>cf2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="c_end">
      <bpmn:incoming>cf2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="cf1" sourceRef="c_start" targetRef="fetch_weather"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="cf2" sourceRef="fetch_weather" targetRef="c_end"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="parallel-process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="p_start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>pf1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="fork">
      <bpmn:incoming>pf1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pf2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pf3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="branch_a">
      <bpmn:incoming>pf2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pf4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="branch_b">
      <bpmn:incoming>pf3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pf5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join">
      <bpmn:incoming>pf4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>pf5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pf6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="p_end">
      <bpmn:incoming>pf6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pf1" sourceRef="p_start" targetRef="fork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pf2" sourceRef="fork" targetRef="branch_a"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pf3" sourceRef="fork" targetRef="branch_b"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pf4" sourceRef="branch_a" targetRef="join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pf5" sourceRef="branch_b" targetRef="join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pf6" sourceRef="join" targetRef="p_end"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
